parsed.answer: To prioritize your next year, focus on building flexible thinking and practical skills through a mix of foundational courses (math, programming, writing, lab science) and exploratory electives. Prioritize real-world practice like internships or projects early on to test fit. A realistic plan involves a steady narrowing of focus: Year 1 and 2 should establish a common core and explore fields, while Years 3 and 4 should deepen specialization in a chosen major or track (e.g., policy/econ or data/tech) with advanced electives and capstone work.
